review_scope: Read two outcome-independent SHA256-selected prompts per source complexity cell, then inspect targeted failure modes and all14 strict-regex failures. These are analytical checks, not timed human attempts.
template_rules: A busy interval includes its start and excludes its end; a meeting may begin exactly when another ends.
A missing calendar day has no listed busy blocks; explicit whole-day/week free statements agree with that interpretation.
Negative before/after preferences forbid overlapping those periods, including shorthand continuation sentences with only a day or day and time.
Earliest availability is required only when the prompt says so; otherwise any feasible slot of the required duration is accepted.
All times in the released first proposals and references use00 or30 minutes. The independent parser asserts this rather than rounding other minutes as the original evaluator would.
Formatting tolerance removes Markdown emphasis/backticks only. It does not mine a correct time from an explanation when the actual first proposal is wrong.
